verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents async job/workflow APIs for processing files at scale, dedicated VPC instances for higher-volume needs, and a free tier of 10,000 pages, but there is no documented rate-limit table, quota numbers, or throughput benchmarks (pages/hour, concurrency limits) for high-volume batch jobs. missing for 10: explicit rate-limit specs, throughput/concurrency numbers, and evidence of millions-of-pages batch runs in production.
